entries.source: Liber mortuorum monasterii Brunnbacensis, Archiv des Historischen Vereins von Unterfranken und Aschaffenburg, vol. 21 (1871)
entries.german: `Julius 22 1227, Adelheydis de Neydeck, uxor Conradi de Rosenberg.`
entries.english: Adelheid von Niedeck died on July 22, 1327. She was the wife of Konrad von Rosenberg.
